description: This file defines SwiftUI views for a dynamic configuration form based on a JSON schema-like structure. It includes the 'ConfigSchemaForm' view for rendering various schema types such as object, array, boolean, number, and string, as well as specific form controls. It also has 'ChannelConfigForm' which encapsulates a configuration form for a specific channel, loading schemas from a store.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Recursively renders UI components based on the schema node type, including handling of objects, arrays, primitives, and variants.

methods.name: renderStringField
methods.description: Renders a text or secured input field for string schema types, including handling of enums.

methods.name: renderNumberField
methods.description: Renders a numeric input field, supporting integer and floating-point types.

methods.name: renderArray
methods.description: Renders UI for array schemas, allowing addition and removal of items.

methods.name: renderAdditionalProperties
methods.description: Handles dynamic addition of extra key-value entries not predefined in schema.

methods.name: stringBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for string configuration values, with trimming and default handling.

methods.name: boolBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for boolean configuration values.

methods.name: numberBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for numeric configuration values, supporting parsing and validation.

methods.name: enumBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for enum selection, mapping options to indices.

methods.name: mapKeyBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for editing object keys, enabling renaming keys without duplicates.
